none: PAS KENT-2DA667: Roman AE3 nummus Phoenix on rocky mound reverse
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A highly worn and degraded 4th century roman nummus (AE3) of Constans (AD 337-350) or Constantius II (AD 337-355). FEL TEMP REPARATIO, Phoenix on rocky mound, minted AD 348-51 (Reece period 18). Obverse: Draped and cuirassed bust right. Legend:llegible. Reverse: Phoenix on rocky mound. Legend: 'FEL TEMP REPARATIO'. Measurements: 17.27mm in diameter, 1.71mm thick and 2.67g in weight
